Structured logging with extra={} context for all log statements

Handle InsufficientDataError gracefully with user-friendly message
Raise QueryError for invalid metrics or parameters

interface.name: get_financial_forecast
interface.description: MCP tool for querying financial forecasts with metric and period parameters

interface.name: generate_forecast
interface.signature: async def generate_forecast(metric: str, historical_data: TimeSeriesData, periods_ahead: int = 4) -> ForecastResult
interface.description: Core forecasting function using Prophet + Mistral Large hybrid

interface.name: extract_timeseries
interface.signature: async def extract_timeseries(document_ids: list[str], metric: str) -> TimeSeriesData
interface.description: Extract time-series data from documents for specified metric

interface.name: ForecastQueryRequest
interface.signature: class ForecastQueryRequest(BaseModel): metric: str | None, periods_ahead: int = 4, query: str | None
interface.description: MCP tool request model supporting structured params and NL queries

interface.name: ForecastQueryResponse
interface.signature: class ForecastQueryResponse(BaseModel): metric_name: str, forecast: list[ForecastPoint], basis: str, confidence_reasoning: str, methodology: str, accuracy_estimate: str, source_documents: list[str], periods_ahead: int
interface.description: MCP tool response with forecast values, confidence intervals, and explanation

tests.standards: Per Definition of Done: New code must have >=80% test coverage measured via pytest --cov. All unit, integration, and E2E tests must pass. Tests should mock external dependencies (generate_forecast, extract_timeseries, Mistral client). Use test database on ports 6335 (Qdrant) and 5433 (PostgreSQL). Follow existing test patterns from test_auto_update.py (26 unit tests) and test_auto_forecast_update.py (13 integration tests).
